objects.name: Analytic 2180
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies new east-west connections between Industrial Control System (ICS) hosts on remote service ports not in the approved communication matrix. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
